evidence: Enlisted v1.2.1.3 archive (read from origin/26.2(main), SHA-256 a0dc616286fc43146e2c6b94ee3bae141a4e6aff65a3fece2370f8388ab057f5): data/ww/index/guns/m1918a2.json and data/ww/data/guns/m1918a2_data.json were checked for this exact GunId, ammo and base capacity.
Each archived BAR geometry exposes its own mag_standard/magazine/magazine_bullet presentation nodes; these assets were used as corroboration rather than as an automatic mechanism detector.
M1918, M1918A1 and M1918A2 are the audited BAR receiver variants; they share the documented 20-round detachable BAR box-magazine interface only with one another.
The sidecar remains runtime-guarded against the loaded GunData ammo and base capacity; each declared carrier variant is an exact selectable first-three extended_mag_ammo_amount value.
